item.title: Charli xcx performs an ambivalent brat send-off in The Moment
item.description: Charli xcx couldn't let the brat era end without a tour movie. But she couldn't leave the tour movie alone, either, in The Moment.

item.title: Nirvanna the Band loads up time-traveling RV in exclusive new look at Nirvanna The Band The Show The Movie
item.description: Party like it's 2008 again with an exclusive first-look at Nirvanna The Band The Show The Movie.

item.title: 5 songs you need to hear this week (January 29, 2026)
item.description: This week's best new songs roundup features Jessie Ware’s piled-on disco-soul harmonies, Sam Goku’s Diana Ross sample flip, and Brown Horse’s lubed-up rock and roll.

item.title: William Greaves died a decade ago, and he just released one of the best movies at Sundance
item.description: William Greaves' stunning Once Upon A Time In Harlem lets us attend one of the greatest parties ever thrown, more than 50 years later.

item.title: Unpacking the shared survival kit of the desert island movie
item.description: Inspired by Sam Raimi's latest, we analyze what makes being marooned on a desert island so cinematic in the first place.

item.title: Rip director Joe Carnahan accused of sexual battery in messy lawsuit
item.description: Two weeks after The Rip tore through Netflix, Joe Carnahan stands accused of sexual battery, stalking, and assault by a former lover. Carnahan denies the allegations.

item.title: Darren Aronofsky, Google DeepMind, and Salesforce proudly present an AI-Mercian Revolution
item.description: Armed with repetitive camera movements, waxen characters, and a human voice cast to satisfy union contracts, the trailer for Time magazine's On This Day… 1776 conjures an ugly look at American history.
